data.description:
Filed from the AS-53 QA review (qa-priya). AS-53 closed the manifest-shaped blind spot (Dockerfile / compose.yaml / package.json are now scanned) and PASSES its own criteria; these are the residual gaps found by adversarial probing that are NOT stated AS-53 criteria. Each was confirmed by planting an unsanctioned `fetch('https://example.invalid/')` in the AS-53 worktree and running the suite in-image (`docker compose -p asc-invoicing-qa53 ... run --rm --build test`): the suite stayed 68/68 green in every case. All three are "silent" (no test fires); item 4 is the opposite class (a loud false positive) and is here only because the fix is adjacent.

1. Closed world is closed over the IMAGE, not the host directory. The Dockerfile copies an explicit top-level list (package.json package-lock.json app.js server.js lib routes views public test compose.yaml Dockerfile .dockerignore + tokens.css->vendor/). A NEW top-level file — e.g. `apps/invoicing/compose.override.yaml` (which compose auto-merges into the running stack) — never reaches /app, so `classifyTree` never sees it, test #3 cannot flag it as unknown, and an outbound healthcheck inside it is invisible. Reproducer: create `compose.override.yaml` with `services: web: healthcheck: test: ["CMD","node","-e","fetch('https://example.invalid/')"]` -> 68/68. The AS-53 plan §2.1/§2.4 wording ("scanned the moment it appears", "visible two-line change") holds only for files under an already-COPY'd directory. Decide: (a) COPY the whole app dir (relying on .dockerignore) so the world is the directory, or (b) keep the explicit list and document that top-level additions must be added to the Dockerfile COPY (deploy-shape.test.js pins those lines, so (b) is already partly enforced by convention — but it is enforced only if someone remembers).

2. SKIPPED_DIRS (node_modules, test, vendor) are matched by entry NAME at every depth, so `lib/vendor/probe.js`, `lib/test/probe.js`, `routes/node_modules/x.js` are walked past silently. Reproducer: `lib/vendor/probe.js` containing `fetch('https://example.invalid/')` -> 68/68. Pre-existing before AS-53 (the plan said "exactly as today"). Fix: skip those names only at the top level of APP_DIR (a depth check in classifyTree), and add a test-#3 style assertion that no nested skip-named directory exists.

3. `stripHashComments(text, {trailing:true})` (and its origin, `stripComment` in test/deploy-shape.test.js, which it duplicates verbatim) has no backslash-escape handling. In a YAML double-quoted scalar, `\"` is an escaped quote; the stripper treats it as the closing quote, so a following ` #` is taken as a comment and the rest of the line — still inside the string — is stripped. Reproducer: `container_name: "asc-inv \" # fetch('https://example.invalid/')"` in compose.yaml services.web -> 68/68, and the running compose stack accepts the file (the value is a legal string). Adversarial-only (nobody writes this by accident), but it violates the stated intent "never inside quotes". Fix in both files, or extract the shared helper (AS-53 plan §11 Q2 proposed the shared-helper follow-up).

4. (nuisance class, not a blind spot) `.DS_Store` is in neither repo-root `.dockerignore` nor `.gitignore`. A Finder-created `.DS_Store` anywhere under apps/invoicing is COPY'd into the image and fails test #3 loudly ("neither app source, a manifest, nor listed in UNSCANNED"). Loud is the correct failure mode, but a macOS developer will hit it. Fix: add `**/.DS_Store` to `.dockerignore` (deploy-shape.test.js pins that file — update its expectation in the same change) and `.DS_Store` to `.gitignore`. Observed by developer-marcus in the AS-53 implementation report; recorded here so it is tracked.

Scope note: items 1 and 3 touch test/deploy-shape.test.js, which AS-53 §1.2 kept out of scope — that is why they are here and not in AS-53.
data.title: invoicing: dependency-policy closed-world scan — residual blind spots found in AS-53 review

provenance.reason: Discovered during AS-53 review; not AS-53 criteria; tracked per CLAUDE.md discovered-work rule

data.body:
PLAN FILED (Owen) — .lattice/plans/task_01M1FF185QBCB1Z9X9F8P9M5WM.md (109 lines); recipes in scratchpad/agent-cto-owen/AS-57/mutations.md.

Item 1 decision: (a). One `COPY apps/invoicing ./` after `npm ci` replaces the eight app-side COPYs (11 → 5); the image becomes the directory minus .dockerignore. Reason: this suite has no host run (README § The three commands), so option (b)'s 'host-side guard' cannot be a test in this suite — it is enforced by memory, which is the finding. Under (a) the guard already exists (test #3 exact lists + test #5 scan) and the record's compose.override.yaml reproducer turns it red. deploy-shape gains a pin: exactly one whole-directory COPY, and no other COPY sourcing a sub-path of apps/invoicing except the cache layer — reintroducing the explicit list is red (M1b). Cost accepted: README.md rides along (UNSCANNED, allowed-if-present); a stray host file is now loud.

Item 2: classifyTree gets a depth; SKIPPED_DIRS applies at depth 0 only; nested skip-named dirs are walked AND collected, asserted empty first in test #3. Item 3: the byte-identical per-line loop moves to test/helpers/hash-comment.js with backslash handling inside double quotes only (YAML single quotes have no escape). AS-53 Q2's 'not until a third consumer' box closed early: a bug in both copies, plus dependency-policy.test.js is at 1,185 of its 1,200-line cap (test #7) — headroom +14 lines, the plan says so. Item 4: **/.DS_Store in .dockerignore (6 → 7, pinned), .DS_Store in .gitignore.

Proof: counted compose runs via apps/chat/bin/compose-run.mjs only (no host suite). Predicted 530/511/0/19 → 530/511/0/19 — new assertions live inside existing tests; the coverage proof is seven mutations with exact red sets (M1 {DP#3, DP#5}; M1b {DS-1, DS-demo, DS-ride}; M2 {DP#3, DP#5}; M3 {DP#5}; M4(i) green + M4(ii) {DS-1, DS-ign, DP#3}; M5 {DP#2, DS-parse}). 13 criteria.

Staffing: developer-lena implements (a second reader of Marcus's AS-53 guard), qa-ruben reviews (Priya filed it). Branch feat/AS-57-closed-world-residuals linked, worktree .worktrees/AS-57 added. Status stays in_planning for the orchestrator.

IMPLEMENTED (Lena) — feat/AS-57-closed-world-residuals, four commits: 08ddbda (item 3: test/helpers/hash-comment.js, both imports, escape cases), 36ca22f (item 2: depth-0 SKIPPED_DIRS + nestedSkipped + assertion 0), 074b69d (item 4: **/.DS_Store + .DS_Store, DS pins 7 + member), 526f0d1 (item 1: one `COPY apps/invoicing ./` after `RUN npm ci`, 11→5 COPYs; deploy-shape pins APP_COPY exactly once, after npm ci, only the cache-layer COPY under apps/invoicing/; README V2b row; UNSCANNED comment).

Final counted run on the tip: 531/512/0/19, `Image asc-impl-as57-20-final-test Built`.

DEVIATION, explained not absorbed: every predicted count in the plan is off by +1 test/+1 pass. `node --test` bare runs every .js under test/** as a file-level test — the five existing helpers already count one pass each (baseline log lines 324–328); the sixth helper file adds exactly +1/+1. No new test() was written. Baseline on the worktree before any change was 530/511/0/19 (00-baseline).

Red sets (each: mutation asserted at site, run, restored, porcelain empty):
- M1 on baseline: GREEN 530/511/0/19 (the before picture). M1 on the fix: 531/510/2/19 = {DP#3 "expected 3 manifests, found 4: … compose.override.yaml …", DP#5 "compose.override.yaml:4: fetch — not sanctioned"}.
- M1b: 531/509/3/19 = {DS-1 "found 12", DS-demo, DS-ride "found 0"}; dependency-policy green.
- M2: 531/510/2/19 = {DP#3 assertion-0 message naming lib/vendor, DP#5 "lib/vendor/probe.js:1: fetch"}.
- M3: 531/511/1/19 = {DP#5 "compose.yaml:32: fetch — not sanctioned"}; deploy-shape green.
- M4(i): GREEN 531/512/0/19, `git check-ignore -q` exit 0. M4(ii): 531/509/3/19 = {DS-1 "found 6", DS-ign, DP#3 "lib/.DS_Store is neither …"}.
- M5: 531/510/2/19 = {DP#2, DS-parse}.

Checks: dependency-policy.test.js 1,195 lines (first item-2 cut was 1,205 and test #7 went red as designed; prose trimmed); `grep -c "quote = null"` 0/0; product code, package.json and .lattice untouched on the branch; harness list unchanged. Boring choices: the escape rule is a standalone one-line statement so M5's single-line delete leaves valid syntax; the .gitignore line carries a two-line comment in the file's house style. Q1/Q2 defaults taken. One harness lesson for Ruben: a backup file left inside apps/invoicing/ is now itself an unclassified file (first M3 attempt) — keep backups outside the worktree.

Logs, receipts, harness: scratchpad/agent-developer-lena/AS-57/ (progress.md, mutate.mjs, NN-*.log/.receipt).

REVIEW (Ruben): IMPLEMENTATION-LEVEL REWORK. Plan and diff read cold; implementer comment/scratchpad and planner mutation list not read (lattice show exposed a transition message naming a count; my counts are my own).

Findings first (4 outside the list):
F1 — DEFECT, behaviour (reachable hole, regression vs master). The whole-directory COPY now ships a host-side apps/invoicing/vendor/ into /app/vendor, which SKIPPED_DIRS skips at depth 0. Run 6: vendor/probe.js with fetch, imported by lib/vendor.js, boots with the app — GREEN. Run 7, same plant on master: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, loud. Nothing pins /app/vendor's contents; test #3 assertion 5 forbids imports from demo/ only; the SKIPPED_DIRS comment ("vendor/ exists only inside the image … bounded by VENDOR_ASSETS") is false twice. Contradicts plan §2. Fix: pin /app/vendor as an exact 2-file closed world (assets.test.js is the natural home; dependency-policy is at 1,195/1,200), widen assertion 5 to every SKIPPED_DIRS name, fix the comment, add run 6's plant as a mutant with its red set.
F2 — hardening residual, pre-existing, analytical: lib/ → '../test/…' is the same unguarded import path; F1's fix closes it.
F3 — plan prediction miss, not a defect: 531/512 vs 530/511 — node's **/test/**/*.js glob counts the new helper as a file-level pass.
F4 — comment nit: UNSCANNED comment still says "must pass in both places"; there is no host run.

Criteria sweep, floor check: 13 examined, 13 pass (counts +1/+1 per F3). 13 counted runs, 13 receipts (Image asc-qa-as57-<n>-test Built); baseline and final restored 531/512/0/19. M1 {DP#3,DP#5} 531/510/2/19, master before-picture green; M1b {DS-1,DS-demo,DS-ride} 531/509/3/19; M2 {DP#3 assertion-0,DP#5} 531/510/2/19; M3 {DP#5 compose.yaml:32} 531/511/1/19; M5 {DP#2,DS-parse} 531/510/2/19; M4(i) green, check-ignore 0; M4(ii) {DS-1,DS-ign,DP#3} 531/509/3/19 — as predicted. Dotfile-manifest and symlink probes loud. Tree clean after each restore; no .lattice/ on branch; 4 commits, all developer-lena; product code untouched.

No inline fixes. Record: scratchpad/agent-qa-ruben/AS-57/battery.md (+ scripts, logs).

REWORK CYCLE 1 (Owen, orchestrator) — review -> in_progress per Ruben's implementation-level verdict. Findings appended to the plan under '## Review Cycle 1 Findings' (plan now 120 lines, at the medium cap). Lena picks it up next tick on feat/AS-57-closed-world-residuals: F1 (behaviour defect — host vendor/ ships into /app/vendor unscanned; pin /app/vendor cardinality, widen assertion 5 to all SKIPPED_DIRS names, fix the comment, add the mutant), F3 (update predicted counts to 531/512/0/19), F4 (UNSCANNED comment). F2 is closed by F1's regex. Triage: nothing filed — F1 is a defect on this branch, fixed here, not a new task.
